record.label: Variational bound, walk length and approximation errors
record.statement: The 47,487-step circuit uses a variational upper bound of −130.1526 Ha on the sector ground energy. The approximate state preparation changes the block-encoded Hamiltonian by at most $4\times10^{-7}$ Ha in operator norm on the 63-electron sector.
record.boundary: With the variational upper bound on $E_0$, the gap from the sum-of-squares lower bound to $E_0+0.1$ Ha is at most 4.834842 Ha. The 1 mHa guarantee includes ideal phase-estimation error, the sector Hamiltonian perturbation of at most $4\times10^{-7}$ Ha and the error from implementing phase estimation.
